mapper.select: SELECT s.*, h.agent_id, v.name AS agent_name, v.version_no AS agent_version_no, v.config_json AS agent_config_json FROM scheduled_task s LEFT JOIN agent_hire h ON h.enterprise_id = s.enterprise_id AND h.user_id = s.owner_user_id AND h.id = s.hire_id LEFT JOIN resource_version v ON v.enterprise_id = s.enterprise_id AND v.id = s.agent_version_id WHERE s.enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND s.owner_user_id = #{user} AND s.id = #{id} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
